note: Great Smoky Mountains NP's largest campground, along the Little River and Jakes Creek, about 8 miles from Gatlinburg. Pads are paved; many sites are too short or too steep for an RV, so check the posted length per site. RVs and trailers may not use the Metcalf Bottoms bridge: come in from the Gatlinburg or Townsend side. Generators are banned May 15 to October 31 in loops A, B, L, M and N. No parking tag is needed for a vehicle parked at its own campsite. --Claude
summary: NPS campground confirmed on rec.gov + NPS data: 211 sites (96 RV sites 24-35 ft), $30, no hookups/showers/dump, flush toilets + water, camp store; season 04-03 to 11-29; reservation-only, 6 months, 14 nights. Riverfront lead: Little River is ~20-25 m wide at the sites -> creekside (sites C01, C02, D01-D06, E03, F01-F08, G04-G14, H05, J10, J12). Phone 865-436-1200 -> 865-430-5560.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade riverfront -> creekside, --Claude value): the Little River channel at Elkmont measures ~20-25 m wide on USGS imagery (Esri is blurred over the campground), under the ~30 m river/creek line. rec.gov tags 46 sites 'Riverfront' and says 'Little River and Jakes Creek run through the campground, offering easy access for fishing'; RV-permitted tagged sites a 23-ft rig fits (24-35 ft): C01 (35.65810,-83.58295), C02, D01 (35.65743,-83.58267), D03, D04, D06, E03, F01 (35.65581,-83.58191), F06, F08, G04, G07, G12, G14, H05, J10, J12 - all reservable nightly, pads ~15-25 m from the channel under canopy. The water at the sites earns creekside, not riverfront. Proposed evidence: 'rec.gov 232487 per-site Proximity to Water=Riverfront on 46 sites, 17 RV sites 24-35 ft (C01, C02, D01-D06, E03, F01-F08, G04-G14, H05, J10, J12) ~15-25 m from the Little River; USGS imagery channel ~20-25 m wide at the sites -> creekside; rec.gov: easy access for fishing or splashing'.
PHONE: 865-436-1200 (park headquarters) -> 865-430-5560 (Elkmont campground: rec.gov facility phone and NPS campground contact).
